headline: Ruby Bridges walks into history
post_facts: Six years old, starting first grade
Taught alone all year by Barbara Henry

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen sixty... a six-year-old girl walked into history.

scenes.label: New Orleans
scenes.caption: U.S. Marshals with young Ruby Bridges
scenes.text: [softly] Ruby Bridges entered a New Orleans school, escorted by four federal marshals.

scenes.label: federal marshals walked her to school
scenes.text: [gently] Angry crowds shouted outside. Almost every white family pulled their children out.

scenes.label: William Frantz
scenes.caption: William Frantz Elementary School today
scenes.title: A class of one
scenes.text: [warmly] All year, teacher Barbara Henry taught Ruby alone.

scenes.title: A walk America never forgot
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Norman Rockwell later painted her walk.

scenes.title: Could you have been that brave at six?
scenes.text: [gently] Could you have been that brave at six?
